properties.title: A Hybrid AI Framework for Sensor-Based Personal Health Monitoring towards Precision Health

properties.name: Reported hybrid ML/ontology/BN AF architecture
properties.reported_validation: Author describes efficacy/validation in cited Wanyana 2022/2023 work, but this two-page version supplies no cohort, split, protocol or performance number.

scope.time_horizon: Forecast horizon and transition coordinate unspecified

assertions.rationale: Prediction is claimed but the source supplies no carried-state transition, elapsed-time semantics or forecast horizon; dynamic Bayesian decision network explicitly future work.

scope.time_horizon: Forecast horizon and transition coordinate unspecified

assertions.rationale: An AF ontology represents sensor observations, personal information and expert knowledge, but no state-variable mapping or inspection mechanism is documented.

scope.time_horizon: Forecast horizon and transition coordinate unspecified

assertions.rationale: BN probabilistic reasoning is described, but outcome posterior semantics and actual reported uncertainty outputs are not supplied.

scope.time_horizon: Forecast horizon and transition coordinate unspecified

assertions.rationale: BDI agent integration is proposed, with cited agent architecture validation, but component messages, operational role and execution loop are absent in this source.
criteria_missing: Operational component role and execution details

scope.time_horizon: Forecast horizon and transition coordinate unspecified

assertions.rationale: Ontology represents heterogeneous health concepts, but source-to-target terminology/unit mappings and traceable conversions are missing.
criteria_met: Ontology representation of sensors and health knowledge
